channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Lucas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Lucas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Jerry West, John Lucas
item.description:
Michael Cooper:

“My relationship with him goes very deep. You know, after I retired, I had alcohol and substance abuse issues. And Jerry—he was the first one to pull me to the side. He was like, ‘Coop, what’s going on?’ And he understoodit. So I went and spent 45 days at John Lucas’s rehab facility down in Houston—probably one of the best things I ever did to turn my life around. Sometimes we get led astray by different things, and Jerry West was able to see that in me. He caught it early before my issues became even bigger—before I couldn’t handle them.”

Michael Cooper on Jerry West, John Lucas, Feb 7, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on John Lucas
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Alperen Sengun:

“We're doing tough practices because we're working with John Lucas, you know, he's crazy, and he's crazy and his practice is crazy too, but I have to do this practice because I'm feeling better. I did practice in Turkey but not like this.”

Alperen Sengun on John Lucas, May 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Jalen Green on John Lucas
item.description:
Jalen Green:

“I’m not going to lie. The rehab situation with John Lucas made the game a lot easier.”

Jalen Green on John Lucas, Dec 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Kerry Kittles on John Lucas
item.description:
Kerry Kittles on his relationship with Kobe while he was at Lower Merion while he was at Villanova:

“I first met him through John Lucas who was coaching the Sixers at the time and John used to have workouts all the time at St. Joe’s [St. Joseph’s University] and St. Joe’s was down the road from ‘Nova. So I’m working out with John and I’m working out with Maurice ‘Mo’ Cheeks and then Kobe comes in and he was the local high school kid and we were like, “Oh snap! This kid can GO! This boy is talented.”

Kerry Kittles on John Lucas, Dec 4, 2021. Source: Bally Sports.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Lucas
item.description:
“All of our guys shoot a ton. (Assistant coach) John Lucas does an amazing job … with the young guys. They’re in getting shots up in the morning and after practice He works a lot. He’s a hard worker. But we also have the structure in place for those guys to do that. They know it’s a priority of ours. “For him to be successful, he’s going to have to be someone who can make those shots. To see the hard work that he puts in pay off was great.”

Stephen Silas on John Lucas, May 1, 2021. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: John Wall on John Lucas, James Harden
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:John Wall on James Harden:

“I talked to him the other day. He came in and got his test. He came in and had a good workout with coach John Lucas. That’s all I can say. That’s all he talked about. We didn’t really talk about too much more. We have a relationship.”

John Wall on John Lucas, James Harden, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Lucas
item.description:
#Rockets HCStephen Silas on adding coaches with head coaching experience to his coaching staff:

“Luke (John Lucas) is already on my staff, Possibly having 1 or 2 more former head coaches.”

Stephen Silas on John Lucas, Nov 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @AdamJWexler.
